items: Variable — A named storage location for a value.
Assignment — Storing or replacing a variable's value using = in OCR ERL.
Integer — A whole-number data type such as 12.
Real — A numeric data type that can represent values with a fractional part, such as 2.5.
String — Text stored in quotation marks, such as "Owls".
Boolean — A value that is true or false.
